cases.sentence: В царствование Иоакима на страну напал царь ___ Навуходоносор.
cases.translation: In the days of Jehoiakim, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the land.
cases.explain: The possessive genitive shows that Nebuchadnezzar was 'of Babylon'.

cases.sentence: Господь насылал на него разбойников из Халдеи, Арама, Маава и ___.
cases.translation: The Lord sent against him bands of the Chaldeans, Arameans, Moabites, and Ammonites.
cases.explain: The preposition 'из' (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Все это произошло с Иудеей по воле Господа, чтобы удалить их от ___ из-за грехов Монасии.
cases.translation: All this happened to Judah according to the will of the Lord to remove them from him because of the sins of Manasseh.
cases.explain: The preposition 'от' (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Царь Египта не выходил больше из своей страны, потому что царь Вавилона захватил все его земли, от потока Египта до реки ___.
cases.translation: The king of Egypt didn't come out of his land anymore because the king of Babylon had taken all his territory, from the River of Egypt to the River Euphrates.
cases.explain: The preposition 'до' (to, until) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Иихонии было восемнадцать лет, когда он стал ___.
cases.translation: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king.
cases.explain: The verb 'стал' (became) governs the instrumental case for predicate nominatives.

cases.sentence: На восьмом году своего правления царь Вавилона взял Иехонию в ___.
cases.translation: In the eighth year of his reign, the king of Babylon took Jehoiachin into captivity.
cases.explain: The verb 'взял' (took) governs the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Навуходоносор забрал все сокровища из дома Господа и из царского дворца, и порубил на куски всю золотую утварь, которую сделал для дома Господа царь Израиля ___.
cases.translation: Nebuchadnezzar carried away all the treasures from the house of the Lord and from the royal palace, and cut into pieces all the gold vessels which Solomon king of Israel had made for the house of the Lord.
cases.explain: Соломон is the subject of the verb 'сделал' (made) and stands in the nominative case.

cases.translation: He made Mattaniah, uncle of Jehoiachin, king in his place.
cases.explain: The verb 'сделал' (made) with a predicate nominative governs the instrumental case.

reading.ru: В царствование Иоакима на страну напал царь Вавилона Навуходоносор, и Иоаким стал подвластным ему на три года, но потом передумал и восстал против Навуходоносора.
reading.question: What happened during Jehoiakim's reign with respect to Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon?
options: Nebuchadnezzar attacked the land, Jehoiakim became his subject for three years but then rebelled against him
Jehoiakim allied with Nebuchadnezzar against Egypt
Nebuchadnezzar built a new temple in Jerusalem
reading.correct: Nebuchadnezzar attacked the land, Jehoiakim became his subject for three years but then rebelled against him
reading.explain: The text states that Nebuchadnezzar attacked, Jehoiakim became subject to him for three years, but then 'передумал и восстал против Навуходоносора' (changed his mind and rebelled against Nebuchadnezzar).

reading.ru: Господь насылал на него разбойников из Халдеи, Арама, Маава и Омона, чтобы они губили иудею по слову Господа.
reading.question: Why did the Lord send raiders from different nations against Judah?
options: To destroy Judah according to the word of the Lord spoken by His servants the prophets
To test the loyalty of the kings
reading.correct: To destroy Judah according to the word of the Lord spoken by His servants the prophets
reading.explain: The text says the Lord sent raiders 'чтобы они губили иудею по слову Господа' (to destroy Judah according to the word of the Lord) spoken through the prophets.

reading.ru: Иихонии было восемнадцать лет, когда он стал царем, и правил он в Иерусалиме три месяца.
reading.question: How old was Jehoiachin when he became king, and how long did he reign?
options: Eighteen years old, reigned three months
Twenty-one years old, reigned eleven years
Eight years old, reigned thirty-one years
Twenty-two years old, reigned two years
reading.correct: Eighteen years old, reigned three months
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'Иихонии было восемнадцать лет, когда он стал царем, и правил он в Иерусалиме три месяца' (Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months).

reading.ru: На восьмом году своего правления царь Вавилона взял Иехонию в плен.
reading.question: When did the king of Babylon take Jehoiachin captive?
options: In the eighth year of his reign
At the beginning of Nebuchadnezzar's reign
reading.correct: In the eighth year of his reign
reading.explain: The text states 'На восьмом году своего правления царь Вавилона взял Иехонию в плен' (In the eighth year of his reign, the king of Babylon took Jehoiachin into captivity).

reading.ru: Он увел в плен весь Иерусалим, всех полководцев и воинов, всех ремесленников и кузнецов, десять тысяч человек общим счетом.
reading.question: Who did Nebuchadnezzar take into captivity from Jerusalem?
options: All Jerusalem, all the princes and warriors, all the craftsmen and smiths, ten thousand people in total
Only the king and his family
Only the poorest people of the land
reading.correct: All Jerusalem, all the princes and warriors, all the craftsmen and smiths, ten thousand people in total
reading.explain: The text says he 'увел в плен весь Иерусалим, всех полководцев и воинов, всех ремесленников и кузнецов, десять тысяч человек общим счетом' (carried away all Jerusalem, all the princes and warriors, all the craftsmen and smiths, ten thousand people in total).

reading.ru: Он сделал Матанию, дядю Иехонии, царем вместо него, и переменил его имя на Цедекию.
reading.question: What did the king of Babylon do with Mattaniah after taking Jehoiachin captive?
options: He made him king in place of Jehoiachin and changed his name to Zedekiah
He sent him into exile to Egypt
He appointed him as a governor under Jehoiachin
He kept him imprisoned in Babylon
reading.correct: He made him king in place of Jehoiachin and changed his name to Zedekiah
reading.explain: The text states 'Он сделал Матанию, дядю Иехонии, царем вместо него, и переменил его имя на Цедекию' (He made Mattaniah, uncle of Jehoiachin, king in his place, and changed his name to Zedekiah).
